QuestInfo.0: A brilliant but pretty weird professor has decided you are his research assistant.

0.0: It's hard for me to keep assistants around! Maybe it's my overwhelming energy. Maybe it's the cosmic energy I bombard them with. Who knows? I'm just happy to have you here. You... ARE going to stay, right?

1.0: If you're going to be a proper assistant, you need to look smart. Here, take my glasses. Maybe some of by genius will rub off on you!
